name: World Bank World Development Indicators — countries, 1990–2024
description: Real World Bank indicators for 217 economies (countries and territories), one row per country and year from 1990 to 2024: population, GDP, growth, inflation, unemployment, life expectancy, infant mortality, fertility, urbanisation, internet use, electricity access, renewable energy, CO2 per person and health spending. Also includes education spending, trade as a share of GDP and adult literacy.
licence_note: CC BY 4.0. World Bank (2026), World Development Indicators, accessed through the World Bank API on 18 October 2026 (indicators last updated 8 October 2026). Aggregates (World, regions, income groups) were dropped; values rounded half-up to 6 decimals; missing values kept as NULL.

planning_notes: Rows are country-years. An average or total 'across' or 'of' the countries in a region, income group or the world is ONE value: dimensions=[] and a filter on that region/group. A change 'from year A to year B' is a compare: filters (target) contain year eq B ONLY, reference_filters (baseline) contain year eq A ONLY, and any country/region filter is copied into BOTH lists; never put both years in one list. Always filter a year (year eq YYYY) unless the question explicitly asks for latest available measurements, a span of years or a trend by year; if a ranking or country value names no year and does not explicitly ask for latest available data, use needs_clarification. Filter a named country ONLY with country_code (ISO3, e.g. India=IND), never with country. Regions and income groups use the uppercase values listed. Totals of people or money use total_population / total_gdp_usd; per-person, percentage and rate indicators use their average metric. 'Top N countries by X' groups by country, sorts X desc and sets limit N. Never invent indicators that are not in the catalog (no poverty or sub-national data). Numeric thresholds may filter any listed indicator using its matching numeric filter field. Explicit latest requests use latest_available time selection and show year; SQL finds the most recent year with all selected indicators present within the filtered scope. Three or more named countries can be compared as a country-grouped aggregate list, retaining every named country. All listed indicators may be requested together.
limitations: World Bank estimates; recent years are often missing for some countries and indicators, and values may be revised in later releases.
Averages over several countries are unweighted means of country values, not population-weighted; totals skip countries with missing values.
Regional and income-group results are computed from the countries in this table, not the World Bank's own published aggregates.
Only the listed indicators are loaded; no sub-national, monthly or forecast data.

Multi-step support is bounded to two scalar scopes, subset shares, and groups above the row-weighted population average; side-by-side grouped comparisons of multiple entities are supported; arbitrary chains and conversational follow-ups are unsupported.
